command.isekai_mahou.spawnboss.class_fai: The boss could not be summoned here.
Another apprentice after my secrets? Come and die like the others!
Enough games! Behold the magic the Tower banished!
Which one of us is real?
Arcane Barrage! Dance between the lines, if you can!
message.isekai_mahou.renegade_archmage.i: Tip: illusions have no shadow, no glowing eyes and no runes at their feet.
message.isekai_mahou.renegade_archmage.w: The Archmage is out of breath and can't blink — strike now!
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_witch.in: Hehehe! What a juicy little thing just walked into my cauldron!
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_witch.ph: You'll be a toad... or an ingredient! Hehehe!
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_witch.dr: Just a little sip of potion...
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_witch.de: My recipes... no... leave them be...
Mortal... break my chains. Or die trying.
Yes! Every blow weakens the seal!
I feel the fire returning to my veins!
Just one more... JUST ONE MORE!
FREE! After a thousand years... FREE!
Feel the weight of my chains!
message.isekai_mahou.imprisoned_patron.n: The soulfire wave hugs the ground: jump over it!
Back... to the abyss... but I will return...
boss.isekai_mahou.corrupted_ent.subtitle: Rotten Heart of the Grove
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_ent.intr: Hrrrm... little one... trampling... my grove...
announce.isekai_mahou.corrupted_ent.rege: The earth... feeds me... (lure it off the grass or set it on fire!)
boss.isekai_mahou.lich.subtitle: King of the Forgotten Crypt
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.intro: The living... in my crypt. How convenient. You will be my new servants.
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.phase1: Fools! As long as my phylactery exists, I cannot die!
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.necrotic: The circle of death... devours the living!
message.isekai_mahou.lich.necrotic: The ring drains your life: stand in its center or get off it!
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.phylactery_hu: Do not touch that! Servants, guard my phylactery!
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.collapse: Hehehe... death is only a pause...
announce.isekai_mahou.lich.reform: You cannot kill what is already dead!
